claims.statement: Pictelio is a single-engine third-party Pixiv client: `pictelio-app-lynx` (vue-lynx) is the only runtime client, and `@pictelio/android-host` is an Android build host (Gradle project, release scripts, native E2E) that packages the Lynx bundle into an APK — it is not a client.

The former SolidJS + Capacitor WebView client (`packages/app`) was deleted by ADR-0203 (2026-09-29), after its runtime went offline at v6.3.0; the OTA web-bundle channel was retired in ADR-0202, and OAuth credentials plus the product version were moved into `packages/app-lynx`.

Root bare commands (`dev`/`build`/`check`/`test`/`preview`) delegate to `pictelio-app-lynx`, while host-package actions are explicitly named with an `:android-host` suffix (ADR-0204, replacing ADR-0059's bare-name target).
The client is version 6.7.1, built with vue-lynx 0.5.1 on Vue 3.5.40 (ReactLynx runtime), the rspeedy bundler, vue-router 5.3.1, TanStack Vue Query 5.103, and Pinia 4.

The pnpm workspace (pnpm 11.9.0, Node ≥ 22.22.2) contains nine packages: the app-lynx client, the android-host build host, six shared pure-logic packages (ugoira, update-check, novel-export, search-core, ranking-core, net-diagnostics), and the Astro website.
Development network access for Pixiv/GitHub goes through a local HTTP proxy read from `https_proxy`/`HTTPS_PROXY`/`http_proxy`/`HTTP_PROXY`, falling back to `http://127.0.0.1:7897`.

The Android debug build chain (`build:android-host`) runs version and credential sync, builds the app-lynx bundle, syncs it into Android assets, then runs Gradle `assembleDebug`; the release variant runs `assembleRelease` plus `renameReleaseApk`.
